description: This file defines the RelationshipHandler class, which manages relationships between modules in a CRM system, including setup, building relationship info, and retrieving relationship details.

classes.name: RelationshipHandler
classes.description: A class extending Relationship, responsible for handling module relationships, setting relationship fields and names, building relationship info arrays, and querying relationship data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the RelationshipHandler with database reference and optional base module name.

methods.name: set_rel_vardef_fields
methods.description: Sets the vardef fields used for establishing relationships between modules.

methods.name: set_rel_relationship_names
methods.description: Sets the relationship names for rel1 and optionally rel2 based on the current bean's field definitions.

methods.name: build_info
methods.description: Builds relationship information arrays for base, rel1, and rel2 modules.

methods.name: build_rel1_info
methods.description: Retrieves and sets the rel1 bean based on relationship with the base module.

methods.name: build_rel2_info
methods.description: Retrieves and sets the rel2 bean based on relationship with rel1.

methods.name: build_module_labels
methods.description: Populates label info for base, rel1, and rel2 modules, translating module names to singular and plural labels.

methods.name: build_related_list
methods.description: Generates a list of related beans based on the specified type (base or rel1) and query.

methods.name: get_relationship_information
methods.description: Retrieves relationship metadata and associates beans accordingly, handling both upstream and downstream relationships.

methods.name: traverse_rel_meta
methods.description: Finds the relationship ID name in a bean's field definitions for a given relationship.

methods.name: get_id_name
methods.description: Finds the internal ID field name for a relationship in a target bean.

methods.name: process_by_rel_bean
methods.description: Sets the rel1 relationship based on a given related module.

methods.name: get_rel1_vardef_field_base
methods.description: Finds the vardef field name for rel1 given the field definitions.

methods.name: get_farthest_reach
methods.description: Determines the furthest relational bean (rel2 if exists, otherwise rel1).
